name: Strong-lens model (SIE + shear, critical curves, magnification, delays)
description: Parametric strong-lens model of multiply imaged sources: SIE + external shear (optional fixed NFW halo and cluster-member PIEMD perturbers), image-plane chi2 fit with fitted source position, Einstein radius and mass, critical curves and caustics, magnification map, predicted counter-images, time delays and a source-plane reconstruction. numpy/scipy; lenstronomy only as an optional cross-check.

params.name: image-numbers
params.label: Image NUMBERs
params.help: Catalog NUMBERs of the multiple images of one source, e.g. 12,15,18,21 (Use selection fills this from the table).

params.name: positions
params.label: Image positions (x,y;x,y;...)
params.help: 1-based pixel coordinates, used only when the NUMBER list is empty.

params.name: lens-number
params.label: Lens galaxy NUMBER
params.help: Catalog NUMBER of the lens galaxy; its X_IMAGE/Y_IMAGE is the lens centre (0 = use Lens x/y).

params.name: lens-x
params.label: Lens x (pixel)
params.help: 1-based lens-centre pixel when no lens NUMBER is given.

params.name: lens-y
params.label: Lens y (pixel)
params.help: 1-based lens-centre pixel when no lens NUMBER is given.

params.name: sigma-pos
params.label: Position uncertainty (arcsec)
params.help: Gaussian error of the image positions; sets chi2.

params.name: pixscale
params.label: Pixel scale (arcsec/pixel)
params.help: 0 = from the FITS WCS.

params.name: z-lens
params.label: Lens redshift
params.help: Needed for the mass, velocity dispersion and time delays (0 = skip the physical quantities).

params.name: z-source
params.label: Source redshift
params.help: Must exceed the lens redshift.

params.name: h0
params.label: H0 (km/s/Mpc)
params.help: Flat LCDM.

params.name: omega-m
params.label: Omega_m
params.help: Flat LCDM.

params.name: free
params.label: Free parameters
params.help: auto: theta_E (2 images), theta_E q phi (3), theta_E q phi gamma phi_g (4+); or a comma list of theta_E,q,phi,gamma,phi_g,x0,y0. The source position is always fitted.

params.name: fixed
params.label: Fixed values
params.help: Values of parameters that are not free, e.g. q=1,gamma=0.

params.name: n-starts
params.label: Starting points
params.help: Number of multi-start optimisations (first = analytic guess, others random).

params.name: flux-column
params.label: Flux column
params.help: Optional catalog column with the image fluxes: adds a magnification-ratio term ln(mu_i/mu_0) to chi2.

params.name: flux-sigma
params.label: Flux-ratio sigma (ln)
params.help: Natural-log uncertainty of the flux ratios (microlensing, extinction, variability).

params.name: nfw-kappa-s
params.label: Fixed NFW halo kappa_s
params.help: Adds a fixed spherical NFW halo at the lens centre (0 = off). Not fitted.

params.name: member-column
params.label: Member flag column
params.help: Catalog column > 0 marks cluster members that perturb the lens (e.g. CL_MEMBER from the Cluster plugin). Empty = no perturbers.

params.name: member-mag-column
params.label: Member magnitude column
params.help: Scales each member with L = 10^(-0.4 (m - m*)).

params.name: member-mag-star
params.label: Member m*
params.help: Magnitude of an L* member.

params.name: member-b-star
params.label: Member b0* (arcsec)
params.help: PIEMD strength of an L* member, scaled as L^0.5 (sigma ~ L^0.25). Fixed, not fitted.

params.name: source-pix
params.label: Source-plane pixel (arcsec)
params.help: 0 = half the image pixel.

params.name: cutout
params.label: Source reconstruction radius (arcsec)
params.help: Image cutout radius around the lens (0 = 2.5 theta_E + 0.5).

params.name: lens-mask
params.label: Mask lens light radius (arcsec)
params.help: Pixels closer than this to the lens centre are ignored in the source reconstruction (subtract or mask the lens galaxy first).

params.name: max-mu
params.label: Magnification map clip
params.help: |mu| is clipped to this value in the FITS map.

params.name: grid
params.label: Lens-equation grid
params.help: Grid size of the image finder (larger = finds faint close images).

params.name: show-overlay
params.label: Draw critical curves and predicted images
params.help: Loads lens_overlay.reg into the current frame after a fit.

params.name: check-lenstronomy
params.label: Cross-check deflection with lenstronomy
params.help: Only when lenstronomy is installed.
